decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered 333/PL001, 333/PL002, 333/PL003, Received 26 April 2011, Flood Risk Assessment, Received 11 May 2011, 333/AL(0)110, 333/AL(0)102, 333/AL/(0)103, 333/AL(0)120, 333/AL(0)121, Received 30 June 2011, Daylight and Sunlight Assessment, 333/PL010A, 333/W1, 333/W2, 333/W3, 333/Window Plan, Received 4 July 2011, Email from Tom Reekie, Received 13 July 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the rear extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment produced by And Architects Limited, dated 10 May 2011 and the basement shall not be occupied until all the measures in the Flood Risk Assessment are implemented.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The roof of the single storey side extension shall be obscure glazed (with the exception of the tiled portion at the south end of the roof), and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension and construction of a basement to the house.
